correctness.rationale: Starting from the verified support-function identities ρ=h+h″, ds=ρdθ, area=(1/2)∫hρ and f_R(ρ)=ρ^(2/3)(1-ρ/R)^(1/3), the first area constraint gives ∫u=0 and second gives r∫v=-(1/2)∫u(u+u″). The O(ε²) area deficit is Q=(1/2)∫[(f_R′(r)/r)u(u+u″)-f_R″(r)(u+u″)²]. Independent symbolic differentiation verifies f′/f=(2R-3r)/(3r(R-r)) and f″/f=-2R²/(9r²(R-r)²). Fourier diagonalization on modes k≥2 gives C_k=(-f″-f′/[r(k²-1)])/2, with k=1 translations, k=0 removed by fixed area. Its coefficient is increasing with k for r<2R/3 (sharp k=2), degenerate exactly at 2R/3, and decreasing toward an unattained high-frequency infimum for r>2R/3. The proposed support path h=(r+εcos kθ)/sqrt(1-(k²-1)ε²/(2r²)) has exactly fixed area and 0<ρ<R for sufficiently small ε, so all sharpness assertions are realizable; no finite-amplitude inequality is claimed.
